notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of 1998, from volume 45 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (45minutesofsanfran1998san, labelled 1998). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 1997: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote list and the motion or resolution number. From 5 November the minutes change format ('Meeting Minutes', with page footers) and some December votes are printed in columns that the OCR scrambles; votes that cannot be read cleanly are left out of the description. The year is the live/work year: a string of negative-declaration appeals and discretionary reviews in South of Market and the Northeast Mission, whose calendars describe the site each building replaced (a vacant lot used for parking, a taxi garage, a former gas station, a vacant motel, an auto parts store, the vacant Best Foods plant). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Three kinds of finding: what the Commission (or, reported in the minutes, the Board of Supervisors or Board of Permit Appeals) decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property, taken from items withdrawn or still continued at the end of the volume, and from environmental-impact-report hearings; and a dated past fact the calendar prints (a 1982 cabaret permit, a 1987 authorization, a building in child care from about 1912). A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion, an item under 'Items to be continued' (whose 'Approved as proposed' approves the continuance), a bare 'Take D.R.' with no outcome, or an informational report is not a decision. Vote counts are the names printed under AYES and NOES; EXCUSED and ABSENT are not counted. Every raw.text span was matched mechanically (whitespace-flexible, per ' ... ' segment) against the page it cites. The minutes name applicants, owners, architects, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field, and a business trading under a person's name is left unnamed. Companies, institutions, churches, schools and named buildings are kept; one architect, Willis Polk and Company, is in a reader_note.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 45 (45minutesofsanfran1998san, labelled 1998) was read: 47 regular meetings, 8 January to 17 December 1998, with their addenda and corrections, two closed sessions (9 April, 24 September), a special meeting on 3 September, the land-use workshop of 20 August, and the special joint hearings with the Redevelopment Agency Commission (15 January, 12 May, 27 August, 17 September, 8 and 17 December), the Recreation and Park Commission (21 May) and the Building Inspection Commission (28 May). Regular meetings were cancelled for 1 and 29 January, 30 April, 2 and 30 July, 29 October, 26 November and 24 and 31 December. Next: volume 46 (1999), then volumes 47-58 (2000-2005); 47 is January-April 2000.
